slots.label: Sun
slots.kernel: The Sun is the centre of conscious identity and life-purpose — the “I” that chooses. Its sign shows how you become yourself; its house shows where.

texts.jungian: The Sun is the centre of conscious identity — the "I" that chooses, and the life-purpose that keeps recruiting the rest of the psyche. Its sign shows how becoming yourself is done; its house shows where.
texts.mundane: The Sun marks what you organise your life around: vitality, visible identity, the roles where you must be someone rather than do something.
texts.energy: The Sun is the system’s power source — the current every other circuit ultimately draws on. Its condition sets the whole chart’s baseline amplitude.
texts.minimal: Core identity and purpose. Everything else orbits this.

slots.ask: Where in your life do you feel most unmistakably yourself?

slots.label: Moon
slots.kernel: The Moon is instinct, need and the felt past — how you self-soothe and what makes you feel safe. Fastest-moving, it colours daily mood.

texts.jungian: The Moon is the feeling nature and the inner child: what safety felt like first, and what the psyche still reaches for under stress. It runs on memory, not argument.
texts.mundane: The Moon is daily emotional weather — moods, appetites, home habits, who and what feels comforting. It shows what you need, as distinct from what you want.
texts.energy: The Moon is the fastest-moving current: intake, tide, replenishment. Its sign shows how the system refuels; its aspects show what interferes with refuelling.

slots.ask: What do you reach for when you want to feel safe?

slots.label: Mercury
slots.kernel: Mercury is how you think, learn and put things into words — perception, speech, and the traffic of the near mind.

texts.jungian: Mercury is the messenger function — how experience gets named, connected and told. It carries the psyche’s translations between inner and outer.
texts.mundane: Mercury covers speech, writing, learning, errands, siblings, and the everyday exchange of information.
texts.energy: Mercury is the signal layer: bandwidth, routing, noise. Aspects to it change what gets through and how distorted.

slots.ask: Do you think by talking it out, or by going quiet?

slots.label: Venus
slots.kernel: Venus is what you value and how you attract — taste, affection, and the terms on which you relate and enjoy.

texts.jungian: Venus is the valuing function: what the psyche finds beautiful, worthy and worth drawing close. In relationship it shows how affection is offered and recognised.
texts.mundane: Venus covers love, taste, pleasure, money-as-enjoyment, and the manners of relating — how you attract and what you appreciate.
texts.energy: Venus is the attracting current — it pulls rather than pushes. Its condition sets how easily the system draws in what it values.
texts.minimal: Attraction, values, affection. What you say yes to.

slots.ask: What do you find beautiful that others around you don’t?

slots.label: Mars
slots.kernel: Mars is desire in action — how you assert, pursue and fight; the body’s will and its temper.

texts.jungian: Mars is the will in action: desire that moves, anger that defends, the courage to separate and to want. Undeveloped, it either erupts or goes limp; developed, it is clean assertion.
texts.mundane: Mars covers drive, competition, conflict style, physical energy and how you go after what you want.
texts.energy: Mars is the discharge current — bursts, thrust, ignition. Its aspects show whether output fires cleanly or backfires.
texts.minimal: Drive and aggression. How you push.

slots.ask: How do you behave when you finally lose patience?

slots.label: Jupiter
slots.kernel: Jupiter is where you expand, trust and seek meaning — faith, opportunity, and the appetite for more.

texts.jungian: Jupiter is the principle of meaning and growth — the inner teacher that says life is larger than this. It shows where faith comes naturally and where excess does too.
texts.mundane: Jupiter covers opportunity, luck, travel, education, publishing and everything that expands your world — including waistlines and budgets.
texts.energy: Jupiter is the amplifier: whatever current it touches, it turns up. Generosity and overreach are the same dial.
texts.minimal: Growth, optimism, excess. Where more happens.

slots.ask: Where does life tend to open up for you without much forcing?

slots.label: Saturn
slots.kernel: Saturn is limit, structure and time — where you meet difficulty, take responsibility, and slowly earn mastery.

texts.jungian: Saturn is the reality principle and the inner elder: limit, consequence, earned authority. What it touches matures late and lasts. Its lessons repeat until taken personally.
texts.mundane: Saturn covers duty, structure, career ceilings and floors, delays that turn out to be curricula, and the rewards of sticking at things.
texts.energy: Saturn is impedance and containment — it narrows current to deepen it. Pressure here is load-bearing strength being built.
texts.minimal: Limits, discipline, time. Where the work is.

slots.ask: What have you got good at only by doing it badly for years?

slots.label: Uranus
slots.kernel: Uranus is the disrupting principle — sudden insight, independence, and the break from what has settled.

texts.jungian: Uranus is the awakener: the part of the psyche that must be free and true even at the cost of belonging. It breaks what has become automatic.
texts.mundane: Uranus covers sudden change, technology, rebellion, and the places life refuses to stay settled.
texts.energy: Uranus is high-frequency interruption — surges, static, lightning. It resets circuits that have rusted closed.
texts.minimal: Disruption and freedom. Where you won’t comply.

slots.ask: Where do you refuse to be predictable?

slots.label: Neptune
slots.kernel: Neptune dissolves boundaries — imagination, longing and compassion, and the fog of what cannot be measured.

texts.jungian: Neptune dissolves the ego’s boundaries: imagination, longing for the infinite, compassion — and equally glamour, fog and self-deception. It shows where you idealise.
texts.mundane: Neptune covers dreams, art, spirituality, escapism, and areas of life that stay chronically hard to pin down.
texts.energy: Neptune is diffusion: current spreading into mist. What it touches gains atmosphere and loses edges.
texts.minimal: Imagination and fog. Where edges blur.

slots.ask: Where do you lose your edges — for better or worse?

slots.label: Pluto
slots.kernel: Pluto is depth and transformation — power, compulsion, loss, and what is remade by being destroyed.

texts.jungian: Pluto is the depths: buried material, compulsion, power and the psyche’s capacity to die into a truer form. What it touches cannot stay superficial.
texts.mundane: Pluto covers crises that transform, power struggles, shared resources, and the areas of life that go through death-and-rebirth cycles.
texts.energy: Pluto is the deep reservoir current — slow, immense pressure that periodically forces total renewal of the channel.
texts.minimal: Depth, power, transformation. All or nothing.

slots.ask: What in you has been rebuilt by something you didn’t choose?

slots.label: Chiron
slots.kernel: Chiron is the wound that instructs — where injury and healing meet, and where you help others through what you cannot fully cure in yourself.

texts.jungian: Chiron is the wounded healer: an early injury that never fully closes, which becomes — precisely through conscious tending — the place you can guide others. Wound, coping, gift: that arc.
texts.mundane: Chiron shows a sore spot that keeps resurfacing as real situations, and the mentoring or healing role that eventually grows there.
texts.energy: Chiron is a lesion in the field that the system keeps routing around — each conscious pass lays down stronger tissue than unbroken wire would have.
texts.minimal: The recurring wound and the skill it teaches.

slots.ask: What do you help others with that still aches in you?

slots.label: Vesta
slots.kernel: Vesta is focused devotion — the flame kept for a chosen work, and what you hold sacred and undivided.

texts.jungian: Vesta is the hearth-keeper: devotion, focus, the sacred flame tended in privacy. It shows where wholeness comes from dedication rather than relationship.
texts.mundane: Vesta covers focused work, service, and the practices kept up faithfully — the desk, the studio, the altar.
texts.energy: Vesta is the pilot light: a small, constant, protected flame the rest of the system relies on.
texts.minimal: Devotion and focus. The tended flame.

slots.ask: What would you protect time for, whatever else was asked of you?

slots.label: Pallas
slots.kernel: Pallas is applied intelligence — pattern-recognition, strategy and craft brought to bear on a problem.

texts.jungian: Pallas Athene is pattern-wisdom: strategy born whole from the head, creative intelligence that sees the design in the chaos — often carrying a theme of talent in a father’s world.
texts.mundane: Pallas covers strategy, problem-solving, crafts and politics — where you win by seeing the pattern first.
texts.energy: Pallas is the pattern-recognition circuit: it converts noise into design. Aspects show what feeds or jams it.

slots.ask: What kind of problem do you see the shape of before others do?
